name: Dream Venom
body:
Price 150 gp

ABOUT

This powerful sedative is often used by medical professionals to put patients under before surgery.

DETAILS

Type poison (injury); Save Fortitude DC 15; Onset 1 minute; Frequency once; Cure 1 save

EFFECT

Unconsciousness 1-3 hours
